head: Google Wallet iPhone app is out in the US, without tap to pay
dek: Google Wallet is now a free iPhone app in the US for tickets, boarding passes, loyalty cards, receipts and package tracking. You can't use it to tap and pay in shops on iOS.
details: The app pulls orders, receipts, shipping updates and travel details from Gmail, and you choose what it imports. It can scan physical loyalty cards, gym memberships and barcode passes with the iPhone camera, and it keeps saved payment cards for online checkout with Google Pay. Google also says it shows purchases its AI agents made for you across Google, with receipts and delivery updates. The App Store listing asks for iOS 17 or later; MacRumors notes Apple only lets other apps use contactless payments under a paid agreement.
where: US, iPhone with iOS 17 or later, free on the App Store from 17 November
means: If you use Gmail on an iPhone, your boarding passes, tickets and deliveries can now sit in one Google app. Apple Pay stays the way to pay at the till.
todo: Download Google Wallet from the App Store, sign in with your Google account and pick what it may import from Gmail.
